title: How Intermittent Socializing Affects Postprandial Glucose Stability — Why Skipping Grandchildren's Mealtime Conversations Raises Glycemic Variability More Than Skipping the Pie in Adults 68+ With Diabetes
description: Examines the metabolic cost of emotional disengagement during meals — linking vagal engagement, chewing rhythm, and glucose excursions in observational cohort data.
